_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve phase_field#0: Allen-Cahn does not conserve mass, the mixed H1xH1 Cahn-Hilliard form does. Verified on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.06 (ne=634, P1 ndof=352), eps=0.06, droplet radius 0.3, M=20, dt=2e-4, 60 steps (2026-08-06): the shipped semi-implicit Allen-Cahn scheme drifts by -2.755e-02 relative and monotonically, while the same mesh/eps/M/dt under a stabilised semi-implicit Cahn-Hilliard on ProductSpace(H1,H1) drifts by -3.516e-16. Both fields stay inside [0,1] to a few percent, so the drift is genuine curvature-driven shrinkage rather than an instability.
